signing: Apple Development engineering-only; no ad-hoc or public-release claim
cameraStorage: Independent 512-MiB loop-ext4 Camera store with per-Unit UUID and camera_access_store_t context; preserve workdirs and VDP labels

permanentIngressHostExtension.binding: Optional closed resources sealed by the existing Apple bundle signature, exact base-program manifest and integration/platform/Gateway source pins; absent on old bundles, malformed fails closed
permanentIngressHostExtension.limits: Only the fixed Gateway Mach-O may be up to 32 MiB; other resource and total limits stay unchanged
permanentIngressHostExtension.lifecycle: Normal Source owner selects only verified runtime/runner, retains private TLS and all base CARLA/Python/UI assets; no proof callback or arbitrary binary path
permanentIngressHostExtension.provenance: Fresh .5 manufacture and matching rootfs update share the accepted Vision platform source pin. Earlier .3 images/manifests remain frozen and are not relabelled.

scope: Signed Vision-only input catalog and tooling; normal EnvironmentService, VMService, UnitService and native Aos component/container owners retain lifecycle authority
trust: Apple signature/identifier/team plus exact base-program manifest and source/image digests. No arbitrary image-path override or Main input mutation.
state: Normal instance selection/configuration and operation journals only; preserve both retained roots, their disks/keys/data and the current DMG
cloud: Production domain selected from existing OEM/SP certificates; own Test-role Unit/model/verification set. Create absent owned objects once with reconciliation, never modify a shared Main model or foreign recipient.
proof: Native OEM activation and actual Aos read-resource consumer, repeat/restart/denial/revocation/AVC checks; diagnostic consumer is not final Perception/Assessment or full Vision E2E
